name: stable-clear-straight-throttle-v1

scope.primary_change: scale positive throttle from the stable 0.08 envelope to a 0.10 envelope only while the existing detector reports a clear straight with no obstacle

evidence.code_mechanism: The effective controller's maximum throttle is 0.08 in every context, including obstacle-free straights; the target-speed and braking thresholds already prevent positive throttle above the target envelope.

hypothesis.failure: Uniformly conservative throttle slows acceleration on clearly observed, centered, obstacle-free straights even though the same limit is valuable in uncertain and curved contexts.
hypothesis.repair: Multiply only positive clear-straight throttle by 1.25, capped at 0.10. Keep cruise speed 48, all braking thresholds, steering, curve throttle, obstacle throttle, compound-hazard behavior, and perception unchanged.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Reduce time spent accelerating toward the unchanged cruise target without increasing target speed or changing any curve, obstacle, lost-road, or overspeed action.

fixed.predicate: existing straight=true AND obstacle is None AND brake=0 AND gas>0

synthetic: At straight speeds 0, 42, and 47, candidate steering and brake are exact to the compound control while positive gas is exactly 1.25x and no greater than 0.10.
At straight overspeed, all actions are bit-exact to control and throttle remains zero.
Obstacle-free curves, straight obstacles, compound hazards, lost-road, invalid-input, and reset behavior are bit-exact to the compound control.
Actions remain finite, bounded, mutually exclusive in gas and brake, and deterministic after reset.
regression: The stable and compound-controller isolated contracts both remain valid.
Existing controller, inference, policy-routing, and package tests pass.
Bare state-dict routing selects the guarded controller while DrQ, explicit exports, and HAIC paths remain unchanged.

abort: Cruise speed, braking, steering, perception, or any non-clear-straight action changes.
The compound safety controller has not passed its prior acceptance gate.
A throttle value above 0.10 or gas/brake overlap occurs.
Any frozen DrQ artifact, official environment file, reserved seed, model.pt, or user video changes.
Any relevant interface, package, or deterministic-reset test fails.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
No paired raw action telemetry or comparable evaluation protocol is attached to the videos.
No environment execution, lap-time improvement claim, submission, or SOTA promotion is authorized.
